cases.title: Stocks in Ports
cases.sum: An analytical dashboard giving a complete, accurate picture of inventory held in ports for better planning and resource management.
sections: Goal
To create an information and analytics tool – a dashboard – that gives a fuller and more accurate picture of inventory in ports, enabling more effective planning and resource management.
Plan
The project began with collecting and consolidating data from every work site: gathering data from multiple sources, processing it and bringing it into a single format.
Result

The consolidated data improved the quality of analytics, sped up business-intelligence processes and delivered insights for strategic planning in logistics and supply-chain management, strengthening the company's competitiveness.

cases.title: Klatz
cases.sum: Identity, websites and social media for the oral-care brand Klatz – ~100M ad visits and a route onto major retail shelves.
sections: Project
Identity, website design and SMM for the oral-care brand Klatz.
Role
Art direction, brand identity, website and landing-page design, visual guidelines, SMM.

hice created the corporate identity, developed a comprehensive brand guide, designed the company website and produced materials for advertising campaigns. hice also curated and managed the brand's presence on social media and marketplaces.
Websites and landing pages
Designed dedicated pages for Klatz product lines (brutal, brutal2 and glamour), which lifted sales of those lines by 3% and increased time on site by 2–4 minutes.
Attracted ~100 million ad-driven visits to the site group over three years.
Reached more than 7–8 million unique users in total.
Impact

After sales through the websites and landing pages took off, the company got onto the shelves of major retail chains such as Perekrestok, Lenta and Metro. From 2021 it also moved onto marketplaces – helped by the website redesign and themed landing pages for each product line.

cases.title: Novonatum (Colief & Bioamicus)
cases.sum: Branding and web design for a healthcare company and its Colief and Bioamicus brands – a corporate site plus 10+ landing pages.
sections: Project
Branding and web design for the healthcare company Novonatum and its brands Colief and Bioamicus.
Role
Art direction, web design, communication design.

hice started working on the brands in 2021 and developed their visual identity within the first six months. Over the project hice built the company website and more than 10 landing pages that helped promote Colief and Bioamicus products, and produced a large volume of digital materials for advertising campaigns in support of Novonatum's marketing strategy.
Websites and landing pages
Design of the Novonatum corporate website.
Five landing pages, one per product (e.g. vitamin.colief.ru, masla.colief.ru).
These attracted ~10 million active user visits.
Conversion of 3–5%.
Average time on site: 2 minutes.
~100 million ad-driven visits over three years.
Impact

Successful sales through the websites and landing pages opened the way to marketplaces; since 2022 most sales have come through those platforms. External traffic to the site and landing pages became a key revenue source thanks to the improved design, which substantially increased the inflow of new customers.
